name: Short 2 - burning_platform_memo
script: In 2010, Nokia hired Stephen Elop, a former Microsoft executive, as CEO. In February 2011, he sent his employees a memo. He compared Nokia to a man standing on a burning oil platform in the North Sea, who has to choose between burning alive or jumping into the freezing water. The memo leaked. Then Nokia abandoned its own software and partnered with Microsoft's Windows Phone. And that announcement did the damage itself. Customers realised the phones they were about to buy were already dead ends. Symbian sales fell off a cliff.
